title: Salman Khan's Maatrubhumi trailer launched in Mumbai, film releases 4 December
headline: ₹11 Maatrubhumi Tickets for Over-75s, Says Salman Khan
caption:
Salman Khan says viewers above 75 can watch his new war film Maatrubhumi for ₹11. He said it at the film's trailer launch in Mumbai on 6 November ("Humne 75 ke upar ke logon ka ticket rakha hai 11 rupaye"). How to book the ₹11 seats, at which cinemas and with what proof of age haven't been announced yet.

Maatrubhumi: May War Rest in Peace opens in cinemas on 4 December, the same day as Shraddha Kapoor's Eetha. Directed by Apoorva Lakhia, with Chitrangda Singh, it was made under the working title Battle of Galwan; Khan says it isn't a biopic. The trailer went online on 10 November on Salman Khan Films' YouTube channel.

Who is the oldest person in your family who still goes to the cinema?
